notes.title: ROC Game Fest 2025
notes.notes: [p]Visit Rochester Game Festival [b]THIS SATURDAY[/b] to play Bait & Tackle before release![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597092/4f192e7818ca0cdae2dfe620187f29e2b1c4acff.png"][/img][/p][p]ROC Game Fest is Western New York's largest game festival, this year over 50+ video game and tabletop developers will be showing off their works. Ours included![/p][p][/p][p][b]Where: Rochester Institute of Technology, THE SHED[/b][/p][p][b]When: Saturday, September 27th, 11AM - 5PM[/b][/p][p][/p][p]There will be lots to see and do this year! Click [url="https://www.rocgamefest.com/"]here[/url] for more information.[/p][p][/p][p]Admission if FREE and open to the public. Hope to see you there![/p]
